# Swift packages holzBar may resolve, one repository URL per line (lower case,
# without a trailing slash or .git). privacy-check.py network fails when
# Package.resolved pins a package that is not listed here.
#
# holzBar links no Swift package (since 05.1: its sliders, launch at login and
# event lock are its own or the system's). A new package must be added here on
# purpose, acknowledged in holzBar/Core/Acknowledgements.swift and justified in
# its pull request.
